Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if available.

## Validation

List checks actually executed and results. For diagnostics, include sanitized evidence or fixture coverage. State unverified environments and acceptance limits.

## Review

- [ ] Demo and live data remain separate.
- [ ] No credentials, private logs, runtime databases, screenshots, or local reports are included.
- [ ] No test or development verification performs real GitHub mutations.
- [ ] Mutation paths preserve server opt-in, operator authentication, permission verification, preview, confirmation, and auditing.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and implementation status are accurate.
- [ ] Existing branch protections and required checks remain intact.
